The numbers

Sixty minutes, or eleven seconds.

Posting the old way 60 min a day. Finding the topic, writing it, filming, retakes, editing, captions, uploading.
Posting with AI 11 sec of your time. Two taps and nine seconds of talking.
The differentiator

The avatar is the easy part.

Anyone can generate a talking head. That stopped being hard a while ago, and every tool on the market does it.

The hard part is everything around it. Knowing what moved in your industry overnight. Turning nine seconds of your opinion into a script that sounds like you wrote it. Cutting it, captioning it, putting it live in the right place.

We built that whole chain into one chat. No tools, no logins, no files moving between people. You never leave the conversation, and the post appears.
